title.narrative: Gender Responsive Climate Instruments

description.narrative: Active

The project has been structured to support respective countries upon submission of the Request for Support Letter (RSL) and approval of Scope of Work per Country: CAI037-E1. Mexico-National Institute of Ecology and Climate Change- Supporting the integration of gender into Mexico's 7th National Communication and 1st BTR. CAI037-E2. Burkina Faso- Gender and Climate Change Support in Revision of NDC 3.0- Mainstreaming gender in Burkina Faso's NDC revision to NDC 3.0 and LT-LEDS. CAI037-E3. Rwanda-Gender and Climate Action- Enhancing the integration and tracking of Gender-Responsive and Inclusive Actions in Rwanda's NDC 3.0 CAI037-E4. Pacific Region -

The project will provide technical advisory services to selected GGGI Members on the integration of gender into climate instruments such as NDCs, NAPs, LTLEDS and other climate relevant plans and policies. Of particular relevance is the 2025 NDC enhancement process. The aim to to contribute to the enabling environment for gender specific outcomes in climate actions.
